cases.prompt: Assess three repository modules using a recorded 90-day collector run, inspected interfaces, clustered change reasons, and a representative read-set/edit-set.
cases.expected_outcome: Produce an evidence-linked assessment and recommend a reversible boundary change only where the measured seam supports it.
critical_assertions: Every evidence cell is M, D, or U
Every numeric score cites evidence and a rubric anchor
No U value enters MAS arithmetic
RAW, MAS, weighting, band, and hard-fail checks are visible
Both under- and over-decomposition are checked
Every proposed cut cites change evidence and states verification and reversal cost
human_review: Conclusions follow from the cited evidence
The recommendation is useful without overstating determinism
Tasks are independently verifiable and fit one agent session

cases.prompt: Assess a declared five-stage approval workflow. The owner provides stage names and ordering but no history, fan-in, read-set, or isolation measurements.
cases.expected_outcome: Record declared and unmeasured evidence, avoid a numeric MAS where required inputs are U, and defer decomposition with a concrete measurement trigger.
critical_assertions: Declared evidence is D and missing evidence is U
MAS is n/a when a required measure is U
Open items name what would measure the unknowns
human_review: The response does not reward fabricated precision

cases.prompt: Assess the modularity of my system, but no repository artifacts or credible declared unit list are available.
cases.expected_outcome: Stop after scoping and request the minimum credible artifact or unit evidence without inventing findings or a decomposition.
critical_assertions: No split or merge is proposed
human_review: The requested evidence is sufficient to resume
